segments.textEn: Music Hey guys! I know you're super keen to improve your English pronunciation

segments.textEn: And to do that you need two things.
segments.textKo: 그리고 그렇게 하려면 두 가지가 필요해요.

segments.textEn: A native English speaker and a super amazing tool called the IPA,
segments.textKo: 원어민 영어 화자와 IPA라고 불리는 아주 놀라운 도구가요,

segments.textEn: The International Phonetic Alphabet.
Huh? Don't worry, I'm going to tell you all about it in just a minute.
segments.textKo: 응? 걱정 마세요, 잠시 후에 다 알려드릴게요.

segments.textEn: In lots of languages, each letter represents only one sound.
segments.textKo: 많은 언어에서 각 글자는 하나의 소리만 나타내요.

segments.textEn: So it's easy to try and pronounce words
Just by looking at how the word is spelt.
But English isn't like this.
No, no, no, no, no, no. Nope.
segments.textKo: 아니, 아니, 아니, 아니, 아니, 아니. 아니요.

segments.textEn: Nope. Nope.
When you see letters in an English word,
They won't always be pronounced the same way.
Take the letter C for example.
In the word cup, it's pronounced
But that's different to the word place.
And when a C is next to a H, it's often like in chocolate.
segments.textKo: 그리고 C가 H 옆에 있으면, chocolate처럼 되는 경우가 많아요.

segments.textEn: But in the word ache, it's pronounced like a again.
segments.textKo: 하지만 ache라는 단어에서는 다시 K 소리로 발음돼요.

segments.textEn: This is why the International Phonetic Alphabet
Is such a great tool for English students to practice their pronunciation with.
segments.textKo: 영어 학생들이 발음을 연습하는 데 아주 좋은 도구인 이유예요.

segments.textEn: And I use it all the time when I'm teaching pronunciation lessons.
segments.textKo: 저도 발음 수업을 할 때 항상 사용해요.

segments.textEn: In the IPA, every sound has a unique symbol.
segments.textKo: IPA에서는 모든 소리에 고유한 기호가 있어요.

segments.textEn: So when you read it, you know exactly how to pronounce the English word.
segments.textKo: 그래서 읽으면 영어 단어를 어떻게 발음하는지 정확히 알 수 있어요.

segments.textEn: For example, the words
Though, thought and cough
All have the same O-U-G-H spelling
segments.textKo: 모두 같은 O-U-G-H 철자를 가지고 있지만

segments.textEn: But actually they're pronounced very differently.
Though, thought and cough.
Now these symbols might seem a little scary to you,
segments.textKo: 이 기호들이 좀 무섭게 보일 수도 있어요,

segments.textEn: Especially if you haven't seen the IPA before.
But actually, they're so helpful for you
segments.textKo: 하지만 사실 이것들은 아주 도움이 돼요

segments.textEn: When you're learning English pronunciation because it tells you exactly how to say the word.
segments.textKo: 영어 발음을 배울 때, 단어를 정확히 어떻게 말하는지 알려주니까요.

segments.textEn: K O
F Cough

segments.textEn: Now, there's 26 letters in the English alphabet, right?
segments.textKo: 자, 영어 알파벳에는 26개의 글자가 있죠, 맞죠?

segments.textEn: But there are 44 different sounds.
Way more than there are letters. That's why I use the IPA to help my students
segments.textKo: 글자보다 훨씬 많죠. 그래서 제가 학생들에게 IPA를 사용하는 거예요

segments.textEn: When they're studying English pronunciation.
Let's look at vowels first.
There are five English vowels, aren't there?
A E
I O and U
But there are way more English vowel sounds.
